newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: One dead in explosion at Czech spa town.
newsitem.headline: One dead in explosion at Czech spa town.

text.p: At least one person was killed by an explosion in a building at the spa town of Jesenik, 200 kms north-east of Prague, police said on Sunday.
A nurse said fourteen people had been examined at local hospitals, including three Poles with first and second degree burns.
"There will be more (casualties), and there are many people in shock," a fire department official said.
The nurse said the blast spread debris in a ten-metre radius, shattering the windows of surrounding buildings.
A fire official the cause of the explosion was unclear.
